name: Allard
description: Allard was a world located in the Occlusion Zone in the Outer Rim Territories. Avar Kriss visited a town on Allard shortly after the fall of Starlight Beacon, as the Nihil explained to the planet's citizens the nature of their rule, and the Stormwall.
lead_paragraphs: Allard was a world located in the Occlusion Zone in the Outer Rim Territories. Avar Kriss visited a town on Allard shortly after the fall of Starlight Beacon, as the Nihil explained to the planet's citizens the nature of their rule, and the Stormwall.
